g.text: UML sequence — Authentication, consent, entitlement and transaction authority (proposed)
Request with token + action context + correlation
Validate audience, issuer, session/client and revocation
Verify current consent scopes, accounts, purpose and expiry
Allow / deny / step-up / review + policy evidence
Denied or safe pending via API; no execution
Action-bound challenge / independent approval via API
Validate proof, same details, expiry and maker/checker
Unique financial command + current policy/actor references
Revalidate account restrictions, authority and availability atomically
Same permitted result; never bypass authorization via cache
IAM proves identity; Controls evaluates permission;
A customer token cannot become a staff token.
Revocation blocks new authorization; existing irrevocable
